title: The Fairness Collapse Phenomenon: Bias Amplification in Language Models Trained on Synthetic Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating true positive rate disparities in occupation prediction (Equality of Opportunity GAP) on the Bias-in-Bios dataset, analyzing token-level likelihood asymmetries between male- and female-associated biographies, and measuring likelihood preferences for stereotypical sentences using CrowS-Pairs and the gender subset of the SoFA benchmark.
